entities.name: Thionyl chloride
observations: SOCl2 activates the substrate carboxylic acid for conversion to the ethyl ester in ethanol.
The input fragment [O][=S][Branch1][C][Cl][Cl] corresponds to O=S(Cl)Cl.

entities.name: Ethanol
observations: Ethanol is the solvent and alcohol incorporated into the ester product.

entities.name: Ethyl ester product
observations: The transformation replaces the carboxylic acid OH with OCH2CH3.
Reported yield is 89.0% at 0 °C for 1 hour.

entities.name: Ethanol esterification with SOCl2
observations: The substrate carboxylic acid is converted to its ethyl ester in ethanol with thionyl chloride.
